bounded_formula_check.conclusion: No independently demonstrated formula/alignment/unit error from this bounded review; retain both fields unchanged, including adverse-era results. Prior source receipt/version/TTM/market-cap tests remain the evidence for causality.
bounded_formula_check.gross_profitability: TTM gross profit divided by positive assets in consistent BRL units and consolidated/individual basis; banks require financial-intermediation account semantics and insurers are not forced comparable. No inverted sign or present-value denominator found.
bounded_formula_check.size: Natural log of issuer capitalization from own-received share counts and prior-session prices of each dated share class. No current-session price, reciprocal, or negation. Positive later-period IC is not proof of an alignment error.

interpretation: Expected signs are diagnostic priors, not gates; contrary signs never justify a sign flip or source change without independent evidence.
